title: Hybrid memory matrices and durable task queues
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for inline-lease durable task queues, zero-sweeper crash reclamation, maker != checker verification, content-addressed step and rating idempotency, ADaPT decompose-on-failure with shared-prefix batch coalescing, and zero-OOM subspace memory matrix rotating-layer iterative training.
boundaries: Workers remain stateless claimants of Tessera durable tasks (things to do) and never introduce a competing production task authority.
Inline lease expiry, maker != checker checks and step-receipt hashes preserve idempotent replay with zero double-billing and zero self-approval.
Hybrid subspace memory matrix projection and rotating layer windows keep optimizer states bounded within configured memory budgets.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for inline-lease durable task queues, crash-replay step receipts, ADaPT prefix coalescing and zero-OOM subspace memory matrix training

value.lets_workers: Reclaim stalled durable tasks (things to do) inline via lease_expires_at without cron sweepers, enforce maker != checker principal separation and dead_letter poison routing, memoize paid model step outputs so retries consume 0 tokens, deduplicate ratings by content/ontology/rubric/prompt/model SHA-256, coalesce homogeneous items sharing prefix P while decomposing only on failure (ADaPT), and train open-weights adapters across time-bounded sessions via subspace memory matrices and rotating transformer layer windows.

flow.when: Reclaim expired leases inline without cron sweepers, replay completed step receipts in 0 tokens, block maker == checker self-reviews and route poison tasks to dead_letter.
Coalesce homogeneous items sharing ontology/schema prefix P into K-item batches and trigger ADaPT subtask decomposition strictly when verification fails.
Compress optimizer states into rank-r subspace memory matrices across rotating layer sessions and enforce AST zero-magic-literal and domain-agnostic naming gates.

value.worked_example: Deterministic evaluation bundle recomputed in test_hybrid_durable.py: reclaims an expired lease inline without cron sweepers, blocks maker == checker self-review while completing distinct worker-beta review, routes a 3-attempt poison task to dead_letter, replays a 420-token step in 0 tokens, deduplicates identical rating keys, saves 10,500 shared-prefix tokens via batch coalescing while triggering ADaPT on failure, achieves 4.0x subspace optimizer compression across all 16 transformer layers, and passes AST and domain-agnostic naming gates.

value.rule: Durable task claims evaluate lease_expires_at < now_epoch inline, transition tasks exceeding max_task_attempts to dead_letter and refuse review claims where worker_principal equals maker_principal.

nouns.title: Inline lease reclamation, step-receipt replay, HarnessTax batch coalescing and rotating layer-session rules
nouns.category_reason: Deterministic control rules governing durable task claiming, retry memoization, atomic decomposition and multi-session fine-tuning.

value.inline_lease_rule: Claim queries select ready tasks or claimed tasks with lease_expires_at < now_epoch, incrementing attempt_count or routing to dead_letter when max_task_attempts is exceeded.
value.prefix_coalescing_rule: Coalesce up to prefix_coalesce_max_k homogeneous items sharing ontology/schema prefix P, saving (N - ceil(N/K)) * P input tokens, and invoke ADaPT decomposition strictly on verifier failure.
value.hybrid_memory_rule: Project optimizer states into subspace_rank rows on CPU RAM and rotate active_layer_window across total_transformer_layers with chained SHA-256 session checkpoints.
